notes:
# v1.4.4 - reading counts, clearer source names, and an honest progress line

- Fixed: reading a chapter now always counts toward Chapters Read and EXP. Some
  chapters open before their title has resolved; the app used to reject those
  saves and quietly drop them, so the counters never moved. A read with an
  unresolved title now records the chapter and its EXP, the app retries once if
  a save is refused, and any remaining failure is logged instead of hidden.
- Improved: the source list now uses one flat, consistent wording - "Provider 1"
  through "Provider 31" - instead of the old "Manga/Manhwa/Manhua Provider N"
  and "Novel Provider N" buckets, so the numbering is simple and easy to follow.
- Fixed: the reader progress line now tracks the real end of the chapter. It
  used to reach 100% partway through, while page images were still settling,
  which also put it out of step with the chapter counter; it now stays in step
  with the counter as you read to the end.
- Note: no action needed on your part - just update and enjoy.
